title: Admission Sequence: Fail-Closed Pattern
summary: WLU uses a strict, side-effect-safe sequence to move from a proposal to a reservation and finally to settlement.
why: Ensures that no work is performed and no state is mutated until a valid, authenticated reservation proof is held.
invariants: Admission occurs before the side effect.
Settlement converts actual work into spent WLU and releases unused ceiling/capacity.
Failure at any step before the side-effect leaves the consumer untouched.
